content.json:
# Bare-metal Fleet Health
A visual operational view built from existing Azure Arc, Heartbeat, backup Syslog, Resource Health and Azure Monitor alert data. Green status tiles represent current evidence; historical alerts remain visible for investigation and audit.

content.query:
Resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines'
| extend ConnectionStatus = tostring(properties.status), LastStatusChange = todatetime(properties.lastStatusChange), AgentVersion = tostring(properties.agentVersion)
| extend Health = iff(ConnectionStatus =~ 'Connected', 'Healthy', 'Disconnected')
| project Server=name, Health, ConnectionStatus, LastStatusChange, AgentVersion, ResourceGroup=resourceGroup
content.title: Azure Arc connection

content.query:
Heartbeat
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| summarize LastHeartbeat=max(TimeGenerated), Heartbeats=count() by Computer, _ResourceId
| extend AgeMinutes=datetime_diff('minute', now(), LastHeartbeat)
| extend Health=case(AgeMinutes <= 5, 'Healthy', AgeMinutes <= 15, 'Degraded', 'Offline')
| project Server=Computer, Health, LastHeartbeat, AgeMinutes, Heartbeats
content.title: Monitor heartbeat

content.query:
Heartbeat
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Heartbeats=count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m), Computer
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Heartbeat continuity

content.query:
Syslog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where Facility == 'local0'
| where ProcessName in ('platform-backup', 'platform-backup-health')
| extend Server=extract(@'server=([^ ]+)', 1, SyslogMessage), Workload=extract(@'workload=([^ ]+)', 1, SyslogMessage), BackupKind=extract(@'kind=([^ ]+)', 1, SyslogMessage), Result=extract(@'status=([^ ]+)', 1, SyslogMessage)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, Result, SyslogMessage) by Server, Workload, BackupKind
| extend AgeHours=datetime_diff('hour', now(), TimeGenerated)
| extend Health=case(Result != 'success', 'Failed', AgeHours > 30, 'Stale', 'Healthy')
| extend Scope=case(BackupKind == 'all', 'Overall backup health', isempty(Workload), strcat('All databases / ', BackupKind), strcat(Workload, ' / ', BackupKind))
| extend Backup=strcat(Server, ' / ', Scope)
| project Backup, Server, Health, LastResult=Result, LastRun=TimeGenerated, AgeHours
content.title: Latest result by backup scope

content.query:
Syslog
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Facility == 'local0'
| where ProcessName in ('platform-backup', 'platform-backup-health')
| extend BackupKind=extract(@'kind=([^ ]+)', 1, SyslogMessage), Result=extract(@'status=([^ ]+)', 1, SyslogMessage)
| summarize Successful=countif(Result == 'success'), Failed=countif(Result == 'failed') by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), BackupKind
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Backup outcomes over time

content.query:
AlertsManagementResources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.alertsmanagement/alerts'
| extend AlertState=tostring(properties.essentials.alertState), MonitorCondition=tostring(properties.essentials.monitorCondition), Severity=tostring(properties.essentials.severity), Rule=tostring(properties.essentials.alertRule), TargetType=tostring(properties.essentials.targetResourceType)
| where Rule contains 'platform-backup-' or TargetType =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines'
| summarize Unresolved=countif(MonitorCondition == 'Fired' and AlertState in ('New', 'Acknowledged')), New=countif(MonitorCondition == 'Fired' and AlertState == 'New'), Acknowledged=countif(MonitorCondition == 'Fired' and AlertState == 'Acknowledged')
| extend Tiles=pack_array(pack('Metric', 'Unresolved', 'Value', Unresolved, 'Health', iff(Unresolved == 0, 'Healthy', 'Attention')), pack('Metric', 'New', 'Value', New, 'Health', iff(New == 0, 'Healthy', 'Attention')), pack('Metric', 'Acknowledged', 'Value', Acknowledged, 'Health', iff(Acknowledged == 0, 'Healthy', 'Attention')))
| mv-expand Tiles
| project Metric=tostring(Tiles.Metric), Value=toint(Tiles.Value), Health=tostring(Tiles.Health)
content.title: Current alert workload

content.query:
AlertsManagementResources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.alertsmanagement/alerts'
| extend FireTime=todatetime(properties.essentials.startDateTime), AlertState=tostring(properties.essentials.alertState), MonitorCondition=tostring(properties.essentials.monitorCondition), Severity=tostring(properties.essentials.severity), Rule=tostring(properties.essentials.alertRule), TargetResource=tostring(properties.essentials.targetResource), TargetType=tostring(properties.essentials.targetResourceType), Description=tostring(properties.essentials.description)
| where Rule contains 'platform-backup-' or TargetType =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines'
| where MonitorCondition == 'Fired' and AlertState in ('New', 'Acknowledged')
| extend AgeMinutes=datetime_diff('minute', now(), FireTime)
| project AlertId=id, FireTime, Severity, AlertState, AgeMinutes, Name=name, Rule, TargetResource, Description
| order by FireTime desc
content.title: Open alerts - select an alert to review, acknowledge or close it

content.json:
### Closing an alert safely
Before closing a historical alert, confirm that the server is **Connected**, its heartbeat is **Healthy**, and the affected backup scope shows a newer **Healthy** result. Resource Health alerts record Azure-observed availability transitions and can remain open after the machine has recovered.

content.query:
AlertsManagementResources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.alertsmanagement/alerts'
| extend FireTime=todatetime(properties.essentials.startDateTime), Severity=tostring(properties.essentials.severity), Rule=tostring(properties.essentials.alertRule), TargetType=tostring(properties.essentials.targetResourceType)
| where FireTime {TimeRange}
| where Rule contains 'platform-backup-' or TargetType =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines'
| summarize Alerts=count() by bin(FireTime, 1d), Severity
| order by FireTime asc
content.title: Fleet alerts over time

content.query:
AlertsManagementResources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.alertsmanagement/alerts'
| extend FireTime=todatetime(properties.essentials.startDateTime), ResolvedTime=todatetime(properties.essentials.monitorConditionResolvedDateTime), AlertState=tostring(properties.essentials.alertState), MonitorCondition=tostring(properties.essentials.monitorCondition), Severity=tostring(properties.essentials.severity), MonitorService=tostring(properties.essentials.monitorService), TargetType=tostring(properties.essentials.targetResourceType), TargetResource=tostring(properties.essentials.targetResource), Description=tostring(properties.essentials.description)
| where FireTime {TimeRange}
| where MonitorService =~ 'Resource Health' and TargetType =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines'
| project FireTime, ResolvedTime, Severity, AlertState, MonitorCondition, Name=name, TargetResource, Description
| order by FireTime desc
content.title: Resource Health event history
